herobrine.command.help:
Herobrine commands:
/herobrine summon <stalker|hostile|elite|watcher>
/herobrine haunt [player]
/herobrine apparition <watch|scare|jumpscare|spike|runner|lurking|dwelling> [player]
/herobrine leaves | tunnel | structure [water] | tree | cobble | warts
/herobrine gravel | marker | herd | miner | window
/herobrine torches | curse | candles | sign | donation | door | fire
/herobrine phantom [add|clear]
/herobrine mode [full|purist|toggle]
/herobrine schizo [on|off] | hauntstate | settings | banish [on|off] | config [herd|miner|arson]
/herobrine shrine [gold] | church | give <iron_stick|iron_sword|iron_helmet|iron_chestplate|iron_leggings|iron_boots|holy_water|the_cross>
The fog closes in when he is close. His own sounds are in the subtitles.
herobrine.command.summon.unknown_form: Unknown form '%s' - use stalker, hostile, elite or watcher
herobrine.command.shrine.success: Built the gold shrine (8 gold blocks, 4 redstone torches) - light the netherrack with flint and steel
herobrine.command.shrine.unknown_ring: Unknown ring '%s' - the shrine is built from eight gold blocks and four redstone torches
herobrine.command.trace.leaves: Stripped the leaves off a nearby tree
herobrine.command.phantom.added: Planted a phantom presence at %s %s %s - mobs will not spawn within %s blocks of it

herobrine.command.phantom.cleared: Removed %s phantom presence(s) from this dimension
herobrine.command.phantom.none: No phantom presence here - use /herobrine phantom add where you want mobs to stop spawning
herobrine.command.phantom.status: %s phantom presence(s) in this dimension; the nearest is %s blocks away
herobrine.command.trace.torches: Took some of the light sources nearby
herobrine.command.trace.curse: Swapped torches for redstone and lanterns for soul lanterns
herobrine.command.trace.candles: Blew out the candles and campfires nearby
herobrine.command.trace.sign: Placed a sign with one line on it
herobrine.command.trace.donation: Left something in a nearby chest
herobrine.command.trace.door: Opened or closed a nearby door
herobrine.command.mode.status: Herobrine mode: %s (full = everything, purist = True Herobrine rules, he only watches)
herobrine.command.apparition.unknown: Unknown apparition '%s' - use watch, scare, jumpscare, spike, runner, lurking or dwelling
herobrine.command.apparition.failed: No open ground around that player - he needs solid ground to stand on.

herobrine.message.banished: The apple burns away. Herobrine is banished to the void.
herobrine.message.returned: The apple burns away. Something out there just opened its eyes.
herobrine.command.trace.tree: Took the logs out of a nearby tree and left the leaves floating
herobrine.command.trace.cobble: Left a block of cobblestone on open ground
herobrine.command.trace.warts: Stripped the wart blocks off a huge fungus
herobrine.command.trace.structure.water: Built a sand pyramid out in a body of water
herobrine.cross.success: He cannot stay. The cross holds, and he is gone.
herobrine.cross.failed: He looks at the cross, then at you. It did not work.
herobrine.holy_water.filled: The cauldron runs dry - this is holy water
herobrine.iron.ward: The iron holds. He keeps his distance.
herobrine.iron.retreat: The iron bites, and he cannot stay.
herobrine.iron.recoil: He recoils from the iron, but he is not gone.
herobrine.advancement.iron_ward.title: Cold Iron
herobrine.advancement.iron_ward.descript: Hammer yourself a piece of iron. He will not come as close.
herobrine.command.church.success: Raised a church - the cauldron on the altar holds holy water (bring an empty bottle)
herobrine.command.church.failed: No room for a church there - it needs 7x9 blocks of clear, level ground
herobrine.command.give.unknown: Unknown item '%s' - use iron_stick, iron_sword, iron_helmet, iron_chestplate, iron_leggings, iron_boots, holy_water or the_cross

herobrine.command.trace.gravel: Left a little mound of gravel nearby
herobrine.command.trace.marker: Placed a gold and redstone marker
herobrine.command.trace.herd: Possessed one of the animals nearby
herobrine.command.trace.miner: Someone is mining stone nearby (sound only)
herobrine.command.trace.window: Made him appear on the other side of a window

herobrine.screen.no_world: Join a world to change settings.

herobrine.steve.name: Steve

subtitles.herobrine.music_haunt: Something is breathing in the dark
herobrine.feature.torches.desc: A single torch standing in the distance, where nobody put one.
herobrine.feature.leaves.desc: Trees stripped bare overnight, the branches left behind.
herobrine.feature.tunnels.desc: A 2x2 tunnel dug through stone that leads nowhere.
herobrine.feature.structures.desc: A perfect little pyramid of sand in an ocean, a river or on open ground.
herobrine.feature.trees.desc: The logs are gone and the leaves are still floating there.
herobrine.feature.cobble.desc: One block of cobblestone, standing on open ground.
herobrine.feature.warts.desc: The Nether's own version of the stripped leaves.
herobrine.feature.gravel.desc: A little mound of gravel, dropped on the nearest flat spot.
herobrine.feature.markers.desc: A single upright block where nothing was standing before.
herobrine.feature.herd.desc: One animal nearby stops behaving like an animal, and watches you.
herobrine.feature.miner.desc: A pickaxe working stone in a tunnel that is not there.
herobrine.feature.window.desc: The face at the window, just outside, looking in.
herobrine.feature.doors.desc: A door swings open or shut on its own.
herobrine.feature.signs.desc: A sign appears nearby with a single line written on it.
herobrine.feature.candles.desc: Candles and campfires go out around you.
herobrine.feature.curse.desc: Torches turn to redstone, lanterns to soul lanterns.
herobrine.feature.donation.desc: Something unpleasant, waiting in a chest.
herobrine.feature.fire.desc: A block of fire, next to you, where nothing was burning. The only event that can damage a build.
herobrine.feature.watch.desc: The classic sighting: he stands a long way off, stares, and vanishes.
herobrine.feature.runner.desc: He lets you see him, and bolts the moment you look or move towards him.
herobrine.feature.lurking.desc: Out on the very edge of the render distance, up to 128 blocks away.
herobrine.feature.dwelling.desc: He stands behind you and refuses to go while it is dark.
herobrine.feature.scare.desc: He is already standing right behind you when you turn around.
herobrine.feature.jumpscare.desc: He materialises in your face with a scream.
herobrine.feature.spike.desc: A silent watcher a few blocks away that lunges into your face.
herobrine.feature.sounds.desc: The footsteps behind you and the cave noises that answer them.
herobrine.feature.music.desc: The fifty second haunting track, played when he is genuinely close.
herobrine.feature.fog_closing_in.desc: The fog thickens and closes in the closer he gets.
herobrine.feature.churches.desc: Chapels that appear out on the plains, with holy water in the cauldron.
herobrine.feature.steve.desc: Summon Steve to travel with you; set him to stay or follow.
herobrine.feature.notch_apple.desc: Burn a Notch Apple on netherrack to banish him, or to call him back.
herobrine.feature.shrine.desc: Eight gold blocks, four redstone torches, and lightning.
herobrine.feature.from_the_fog.desc: The bundled From The Fog content by Lunar Eclipse Studios. Opt-in, so it starts off.
herobrine.screen.tab.name: Name
herobrine.screen.section.world: The traces he leaves in the world
herobrine.screen.section.presence: The bigger pieces of the mod
herobrine.screen.section.name: The name he goes by
herobrine.screen.name: His name
herobrine.screen.desc.name: Used wherever he turns up as a player: the fake join and leave lines, his chat messages, his nametag, the jumpscare subtitle, his death messages and the signs he leaves. Letters, numbers and underscores, 16 characters at most.
herobrine.screen.name.invalid: Letters, numbers and underscores only, %d characters at most.
herobrine.command.settings.name: Name: %s
herobrine.command.config.name.invalid: That is not a name he can use: letters, numbers and underscores, %d characters at most.
herobrine.command.feature.off: %s is switched off in this dimension
herobrine.command.config.musictest.playi: Playing the haunting track at %s. If you hear nothing, check the Music volume slider in your sound options.
herobrine.command.config.musictest.silen: The haunting track cannot play: music is %s and the volume is %s.
